ADDRESS_REDACTION: REDACTED, NOT DELETED. Each rented box's public IPv4 was replaced by sha256(address)[:16]. THE CLAIM THIS FILE MAKES IS DISTINCTNESS -- that the shards ran on different physical machines, which host_id cannot establish because one host_id is a provider ACCOUNT operating many machines -- and three distinct digests carry it exactly as well as three addresses. NOT A CRYPTOGRAPHIC GUARANTEE: IPv4 is a 32-bit space, so the digest is recoverable by exhaustive search; what the substitution buys is removal from the plaintext surface that code search and automated scanners read. The instances were destroyed in August 2026. The SSH HostPort was dropped entirely -- it proved nothing.
